system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
Supports inter-node variables (`{agent1Output}`), date/time variables, and custom
variables defined directly in the workflow JSON, with optional Jinja2 templating for advanced logic.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts are per-node workflow templates with variable substitution; quote may span a line break in the source.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
a searchable
vector database (keyword search by default, with optional embedding-based semantic/hybrid search)
env_context_strategy.note: Chat middleware, not a repo environment; context comes from memory files, summaries and keyword FTS5 retrieval configured per workflow. Closest value mismatch.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: a continuously updated "rolling summary" of the entire chat
context_compaction.note: ContextCompactor node also exists (context_compactor_handler.py); summarization via workflow memory nodes.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
This layer's job is to return **raw, unformatted data** from the backing
APIs.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
Full OpenAI-style tool calling passthrough, including reliable multi-round tool loops through authored-prompt
workflows (`appendNativeToolExchange`).
tool_call_format.note: Primary tool invocation is workflow-author-defined nodes, not model-chosen.

tool_count.note: Tools are passthrough from client or workflow nodes; no fixed tool list.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
Each node can
orchestrate different LLMs, call external tools, run custom scripts, call other workflows
edit_primitive.note: No file-edit tool among node handlers; SaveCustomFile node writes files by workflow, not model edit primitive.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote:
Experimental support for agentic MCP server tool
calling, allowing the model to discover and use tools mid-workflow.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: mcp 1.28.1 - Model Context Protocol client (MCPToolCall node)

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The `$WorkflowProcessor$` iterates through each node in the workflow configuration.
loop_primitives.note: Conditional routing between workflows; MCP tool loops react-style are opt-in.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
giving the
user granular control of the path the LLMs take
planning_granularity.note: Plans are human-authored workflows, not model plan objects.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
A single prompt to Wilmer could reach out to 5+ computers,
including proprietary APIs, depending on how you build your workflow.
multi_agent_topology.note: Multiple LLMs chained by workflow nodes.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
Nodes can call an LLM, run a Python script (tool), manage conversational memory, or
trigger another workflow.
delegation_mechanism.note: Sub-workflows are fixed configuration, not agent spawning.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
This data structure encapsulates all runtime
information for a single operational step, including the full conversation history, the current node's configuration, and
outputs from previous nodes.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote:
a chronological summary file, a continuously updated "rolling summary" of the entire chat, a searchable
vector database
long_term_memory.note: Vector DB is SQLite FTS5 keyword by default; embeddings optional.

self_verification.note: Iterative follow-up nodes are user-authored workflows.

termination_condition.note: Workflow ends when node sequence completes.

cost_controls.evidence_quote:
using a small, fast local model for summarization
and a large cloud model for the final reasoning
cost_controls.note: README: WilmerAI does not track token usage.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
PythonModule workflow nodes execute user-provided Python scripts from the configured scripts
directory with the full privileges of the Wilmer process.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote:
These scripts are not sandboxed or
validated by Wilmer.

network_policy.evidence_quote:
The WebFetch and
CurlCommand nodes additionally support an opt-in SSRF guard (blockPrivateAddresses / allowedHosts)

permission_model.evidence_quote:
These scripts are not sandboxed or
validated by Wilmer.

tracing.evidence_quote: At DEBUG level, logs may contain full prompts and LLM responses

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: WilmerAI is an application designed for advanced semantic prompt routing and complex task orchestration.
eval_hooks.note: No eval runner in file tree.

guardrails.evidence_quote: all log statements that could contain user content are automatically redacted.
guardrails.note: Action policy = opt-in SSRF allowedHosts guard; output filter = think-tag stripping/log redaction.

target_domain.evidence_quote: WilmerAI is an application designed for advanced semantic prompt routing and complex task orchestration.

open_source.evidence_quote: the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: It connects to various LLM backends (OpenAI, Ollama, KoboldCpp)
